topic: Explains sleep pressure (process S) and the body clock (process C) and why a baby who looks tired still wakes after 30 minutes
age_target: mixed (babies in general, no age given)
slide1_hook_he: ? / התינוק שלך מתעורר אחרי 30 דקות שינה / יכול להיות שלחץ השינה שלו פשוט... לא מספיק גבוה.
slide1_visual: No people or picture: a big white question mark with purple sunburst rays on a charcoal-black card, white circled arrow at the bottom
art_style: flat graphic text cards (Canva-style sunburst template), no photo and no illustration; an early-format carousel, different from her later illustrated ones
palette: charcoal black, blush beige, sage green, bright orchid purple, cream, light pink; background colour changes every slide
text_layout: centred text block in the middle, one bold Heebo-like headline plus 2-4 lines of thin body text, handwritten-script number label (#1 to #6) above each headline, thin white sunburst rays around the text, circled arrow bottom centre on slides 1-7; one underlined phrase on some slides

structure.text_he_short: התינוק שלך מתעורר אחרי 30 דקות שינה
#1 לחץ שינה = הצורך של הגוף לישון
#2 יש שני מנגנונים שמווסתים את השינה
אפשר לשפר הכל / עקבו אחרי (with logo and website)

numbered_points: 6 numbered points, labelled #1 to #6 in a handwritten script above the headline
brand_presence: Nothing on slides 1-7; last slide only: round LL logo with Lotem Lerner name, service line and www.lotemlerner.com. Caption asks to comment if they knew the term and to save.
caption_summary: Medium-length caption that repeats the opening quote, says what the carousel explains, asks for a comment and a save, plus a medical disclaimer line; no hashtags
what_makes_it_work: A single clear concept explained in one idea per slide with a numbered rhythm and a curiosity hook that names a pain every parent knows (baby wakes after a short sleep). The visuals are only text, which is the weakest part: only 34 likes and 7 comments, no keyword CTA.
lumebook_takeaway: A text-only card format with a numbered rhythm is easy to produce but did not draw engagement here; a kids' book brand should pair a clear hook with a character picture instead.
